done_when: When the test command runs Vitest or Jest, Forge adds --maxWorkers with the machine budget, as it adds --maxprocesses for pytest, and tests cover Vitest, Jest and a runner left as written

known.title: Preserve npm lifecycle hooks when replacing a script's worker cap
Follow-up: Cap the launcher forms Forge already recommends

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. `jest --runInBand` becomes `jest --runInBand --maxWorkers=2`. [Jest rejects these options together](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jestjs/jest/main/packages/jest-cli/src/args.ts), so Forge now fails before running tests. This affects direct commands, npx and visible package scripts, including the existing supported script in `tests/test_quick_test_suggestions.py:31`. Preserve serial execution, including its `-i` alias, instead of adding a conflicting worker option.
findings.title: Preserve Jest's serial execution mode

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. A script such as `"test": "vitest run --maxWorkers=8"` makes Forge replace `npm test` with `npm exec --no -- vitest run --maxWorkers=2`. New evidence beyond the fixed-cap ruling: [npm test runs pretest and posttest hooks](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/using-npm/scripts/), whereas this direct execution bypasses them. Repositories that generate fixtures in pretest now fail, and checks in posttest silently disappear. Adjusting the cap must retain the configured script's lifecycle.
findings.title: Preserve npm lifecycle hooks when replacing a script's worker cap

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 2
`npx --no-install vitest run` loses only its `npx` token, leaving `--no-install` as the presumed runner, so it receives no cap. Configured `npm exec vitest` and `pnpm exec jest` also remain uncapped because `exec` is treated as a package script name. These are existing supported command forms in `tests/test_quick_test_suggestions.py:29`, `:33` and `:45`, including generated fast_test suggestions. They therefore retain the worker oversubscription this fix addresses.
findings.title: Follow-up: Cap the launcher forms Forge already recommends

why: Test runs cap pytest's workers to the machine budget but leave Vitest and Jest at one worker per core, so parallel rounds overload the machine (issue 924)
